artifacts.name: CH-palm.png
artifacts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Generate one finished premium landscape 16:9 illustrated companion-app key visual, largest supported native landscape resolution, target at least 1672x941. Title for metadata only: 掌心相贴. No visible title or text.
Reference image 1 (A1-keyart) is the exact Xiaoman identity, room style and illustration-quality reference. Reference image 2 (A5-avatar-creator) supplies Ayu's charcoal hoodie sleeve/material identity only. Use references as design continuity, not a collage.
SCENE: A rainy-night home table in the approved Across the Table world: polished warm dark wood, rain-speckled broad window, deep blue city bokeh beyond; warm shaded brass table lamp at screen left, delicate white flowers, the two familiar blue ceramic mugs with little floral decoration placed safely on the table, quiet cozy personal interior. The camera IS the seated viewer Ayu. Exactly ONE visible human character across the table: Xiaoman, early 20s, identical gentle semi-realistic anime face to A1, shoulder-length chestnut hair, soft wispy bangs, the same small gold star hairclip on the same side as A1, cream cable-knit oversized cardigan over white tee, tiny thin gold pendant necklace. Half-body framing; table hides lower body. Do not show a second person or any face in window reflections.
ACTION: an intimate wholesome mutual online palm-touch moment. Xiaoman leans slightly forward, eyes gently closed, a relaxed warm smile. Ayu extends ONE hand from the near foreground with charcoal ribbed hoodie cuff. Xiaoman extends ONE hand from her far side with cream knit cuff. Their open palms meet vertically at the exact middle of the table in a gentle stationary palm-to-palm touch, fingers naturally extended and aligned, simple clean anatomically plausible five-finger silhouettes. Carefully preserve clear continuous wrist/forearm ownership: foreground Ayu hand attaches to the near charcoal sleeve; partner hand attaches to Xiaoman's visible cream-knit forearm. Show both wrist connections and enough of both hand silhouettes to make two palms pressing together unmistakable, not a handshake, not interlaced fingers. Position the touch below and beside her face so it never obscures her face. A very soft small amber light bloom ONLY at the palm contact point, subtle reflected warmth on skin, no magic ring, no halo, no outline. Xiaoman's other hand may rest calmly beside her mug.
STYLE: match A1 and A5 high-end 2D anime CG key-visual quality; clean delicate linework, sophisticated soft cel shading plus painterly gradients, luminous subsurface skin, intricate but controlled hair strands, rich knit texture, convincing anatomy and props, NOT photoreal, NOT 3D, NOT chibi. Warm practical lamp key versus blue rainy-night ambient rim; tasteful bloom, bokeh, shallow depth of field, foreground/midground/background separation. Faces and contact hands sharp. Story is person-to-person warmth.
AVOID: additional people, duplicated arms, detached hands, extra/missing fingers, deformed touch, glowing rings/interaction outlines/pins, UI, captions, logos, watermarks, franchise resemblance, viewer face, literal window reflections.

artifacts.name: CH-cheers.png
artifacts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Generate one finished premium landscape 16:9 illustrated companion-app key visual, largest supported native landscape resolution, target at least 1672x941. Title for metadata only: 碰杯. No visible title or text.
Reference image 1 (A1-keyart) is exact Xiaoman clothing sleeve and quality reference. Reference image 2 (A5-avatar-creator) is the exact Ayu face, hairstyle, thin round glasses and charcoal hoodie reference. Keep Ayu unmistakably identical to the central portrait in A5; ignore A5 UI.
SCENE: a distinct intimate neighborhood café table in the same Across the Table visual world, not the home apartment: small round honey-walnut table; upholstered moss/teal banquette behind partner; rain-kissed café window with softly blurred street café lights; a small warm amber table light, framed simple abstract art, distant brass espresso equipment in soft bokeh. Warm caramel-and-teal café palette with warm practical light and blue rainy-window rim. Exactly ONE visible person: Ayu sits directly across the table facing camera, half-body composition, table hides lower body. Camera IS Xiaoman seated opposite him, her body/face offscreen. No other café customers, no window reflections of people.
ACTION: both real people online, a joyful cocoa toast. Ayu mid 20s, dark navy-black tousled hair, thin round glasses, charcoal hoodie, laughing warmly with relaxed partially closed eyes. He reaches his ceramic cocoa cup toward the viewer with one anatomically correct hand. In the near foreground Xiaoman's one hand and cream cable-knit cardigan sleeve enter from below holding her matching cocoa mug. The two mugs clearly CLINK at their upper outer rims near the center of frame; cup bodies remain separate, handles usable, grips physically believable with clean fingers. Tiny few cocoa droplets rise from the liquid at impact, a small restrained splash, no mess; 2 or 3 tiny warm sparkle glints at the exact point of rim contact, no ring, no halo. The visible laughing partner and playful tilt of the viewer's mug communicate both are laughing. Keep the mugs/contact below his face, show face/round glasses fully. Small pastry on side plate and napkin remain subordinate.
STYLE LOCK: identical premium 2D anime CG to A1/A5, original characters, semi-realistic anime proportions, fine line art, soft cel shading and painterly gradients, warm skin scattering, detailed controlled hair highlights, fabric weave, glazed ceramic texture. Strong foreground/midground/background depth, cinematic gentle bloom and shallow bokeh, high craft. Face and hands clean and sharp.
AVOID: Xiaoman's face/body, second full human, extra hands or fingers, cup fusion, implausible liquid, overt UI, text/captions, outlines/interaction rings/pins, logos/watermarks, photorealism, chibi, 3D engine look, franchise characters.

artifacts.name: CH-blanket.png
artifacts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Generate one finished premium landscape 16:9 illustrated companion-app key visual, largest supported native landscape resolution, target at least 1672x941. Metadata title: 盖毯子.
Reference image 1 A1-keyart is the exact Xiaoman identity, warm rainy home room and rendering-style reference. Reference image 2 A5-avatar-creator is Ayu charcoal hoodie sleeve/material reference only; do not reproduce its panels.
SCENE: same home wooden table at a late rainy night; dimmed warm shaded lamp screen left, rain and deep blue city bokeh outside, familiar floral blue ceramic cup safely away from sleeping arms; one partner only across the table, no people in reflections. Camera IS seated viewer Ayu. Half-body Xiaoman from across the table, lower body hidden by table. She has explicitly set her real status to asleep; represent that quiet chosen state, no invented activity. Xiaoman identical to A1: shoulder-length chestnut hair, soft wispy bangs, small gold star clip on same side, tiny gold necklace, cream cable-knit cardigan over white tee. She has her head sideways resting comfortably on her own folded forearms on table, both eyes closed, a faint peaceful sleeping smile. Keep her familiar face partly front-facing and unobstructed, with the star clip visible.
ACTION: foreground viewer Ayu's TWO correctly connected hands and charcoal ribbed hoodie sleeves gently drape a soft knitted blanket over Xiaoman's shoulders. Show the left viewer hand gripping the near left blanket corner and the right viewer hand gripping the near right corner, natural five-finger grips, both arms enter separately from the bottom of frame. Blanket lies naturally across her shoulders and upper back without covering her face, physically plausible folds and sag, distinguish its muted warm oatmeal/slate knit from her cream cardigan. Her own forearms remain folded under head, do not merge with viewer arms. Frame slightly intimate and closer across a compact table so seated viewer can plausibly reach her shoulders; do not make arms unnaturally long. Gentle dim warm light and a thin blue hair rim, quiet late-night atmosphere. No light effects around objects.
Only UI element: a very small neutral frosted-glass rounded voice chip near her but clear of face, fine pale rim, tiny simple audio-wave icon and exact two Chinese characters "晚安" in clean legible off-white type. Tiny respectful chip, not a large speech bubble, no additional labels or UI.
STYLE: premium 2D anime CG illustration at the same A1/A5 key-visual quality, fine clean line art, soft cel shading plus painterly gradients, delicate warm skin scattering, detailed hair highlights, sophisticated textile detail, cinematic light, soft bloom and shallow background bokeh, strong layer depth. Wholesome care between real people.
AVOID: extra characters, visitor silhouettes/reflections, duplicated limbs, extra fingers, floating blanket corners, unnatural reach, closed eyes that look unconscious/distressed, erotic framing, glowing rings, outlines/halos, pins, logos/watermarks, other text, photoreal or 3D or chibi rendering.

revisions.reason_zh: 根审核确认原图台灯仍强亮，未落实用户要求的 dimmed lamp。仅重光该张。
revisions.prompt:
Use case: lighting-weather, precise local lighting edit. Edit reference image 1 CH-blanket.png ONLY to correct the too-bright bedside/table lamp. Reference image 2 A1-keyart.png is Xiaoman's identity/style reference only, NOT the desired brightness.
Preserve reference image 1's exact 1672x941 landscape composition, Xiaoman's identical face/hair/gold star clip/necklace, closed eyes and gentle sleeping smile, head resting on folded cream-cardigan arms, both foreground Ayu charcoal sleeves and both hands gripping the blanket, every pose and finger placement, blanket drape, table and blue ceramic mug, rainy-night window/city placement, and the small frosted voice chip with perfectly legible Chinese text "晚安".
Targeted correction: the LEFT TABLE LAMP IS DIMMED TO A VERY LOW, GENTLE NIGHT LIGHT. Its shade should visibly read as a dim warm muted honey/amber shade with clearly visible pleat texture, not a luminous yellow-white glowing panel. Reduce the light physically emitted from that lamp by approximately 75%, and locally reduce its reflected illumination on nearby flowers, brass base, left wall, nearby tabletop and hair edge accordingly. Slightly darken those surrounding room surfaces to establish a sleepy late-night ambience. Reduce the bright foreground candle glow consistently as needed so it does not defeat the dimmed lamp. Preserve soft readable warm illumination on Xiaoman's face and hands, keeping her natural creamy skin colours and a subtle cool blue window rim. The city/rain outside stays dark blue and is never overexposed.
This is a RELIGHTING EDIT, not a global dark overlay: retain rich local colour, clear facial detail, original brushwork/linework and cloth texture. The lamp shade specifically must look clearly darker and dimmer than reference image 1. Keep character face readable, gentle and attractive, no grey muddy skin. No redesign, no change of room, no change of props, no text changes, no extra UI or light halos. Deliver one finished image same landscape ratio and native 1672x941 or larger supported resolution.
